summary: `users invite` is the POST /users/invite endpoint command (the press name) and carries the cancel/resend children; duplicate AddCommand registrations (contacts duplicate-proposals, users invite) and the generated `create` alias on email post-opt-out-list (it shadowed email send's) are removed. Prose: reprint-637-full-public-api.md, round 4. Reprint gocli1219: 4.34.2 renames the children to `users item-invite ...` and refuses the old paths; this tree keeps `users invite post-users-id-cancel|resend` (the 4.34.2 users_item_invite*.go files are not carried) and TestDeclaredAPISurfaceReachable lists the kept paths.
reason: The press names the endpoint and the sub-resource group alike and keeps only the group, so POST /users/invite was unreachable from the CLI; cobra keeps duplicate children silently.
validated_outcome: 943/943 spec operations reachable through exactly one command; no duplicate sibling names or aliases. TestEverySpecOperationHasExactlyOneCommand, TestSiblingCommandNamesAreUnique.
upstream_issue: For the press board (not filed): an endpoint whose name equals a sub-resource group must become the group command (or a named child), never vanish.
